title: Maximum resale prices across heterogeneous local markets
title_zh: 异质地方市场中的最高转售价格
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study maximum resale prices across heterogeneous local markets that share a common target retail price. A sufficiently small retailer margin can make the ceiling bind across markets, allowing common terms to implement this price. Two-part tariffs instead require the marginal wholesale price to align the retailer’s unconstrained optimal price exactly with the target. If the ceiling already binds, changes in market structure require no contractual recalibration. Apple’s use of list prices as de facto maximum resale prices, combined with discounts from those prices for independent resellers, illustrates a setting in which the mechanism may be relevant.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在共享统一目标零售价格的异质性地方市场中，最高转售价格的表现。当零售商利润率足够低时，价格上限可能在各市场间产生约束效应，使得统一条款能够实现该目标价格。相比之下，两部收费制要求边际批发价格精确匹配零售商无约束最优价格与目标价格。若价格上限已产生约束，市场结构变化无需重新调整合同条款。苹果公司将标价作为事实上的最高转售价格，同时为独立经销商提供折扣的做法，揭示了该机制可能适用的场景。

title: Spreading Out Across Expanding Idea Space
title_zh: 在扩张的思想空间中扩散
authors: Ina Ganguli, Jeffrey Lin, Vitaly Meursault, Nicholas F. Reynolds
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Over nearly two centuries, US inventions have become increasingly dissimilar: not just fewer head-to-head collisions between inventors, but growing distance between neighboring inventions. We document this secular decline in similarity using validated neural language models applied to the full text of claims in over 11 million US patents (1836–2023), corroborated by a 98% decline in patent interference rates, a measure of independent simultaneous invention. Measuring this correctly requires validation, since different representations of the same patent text can yield opposite conclusions about whether inventions are converging or spreading out. Our validation framework, the first systematic comparison for patent text, selects among these representations. We develop a spatial competition model in which inventors choose locations in idea space. The model explains spreading out and connects it to several independently documented patterns — rising R&D investment per inventor, increasing patent values, weakening knowledge spillovers, and declining research productivity. The mechanism is spatial; as inventors spread out to capture new territory, inventions become more valuable but also more costly for others to absorb. In doing so, the model turns spillover intensity, innovation step size, and research productivity from fixed primitives into outcomes of inventor positioning. A calibrated decomposition attributes roughly 40% of the long-run decline in US research productivity to these spatial forces, alongside traditional explanations such as fishing out and the burden of knowledge. Where inventors stand relative to each other in idea space matters as much for growth as how many of them there are.
abstract_zh: 近两个世纪以来，美国发明呈现出日益显著的异质性：不仅发明者之间的直接竞争减少，相邻发明间的距离也在不断扩大。我们通过将经过验证的神经语言模型应用于超过1100万件美国专利（1836-2023年）的权利要求全文，并结合专利抵触率（衡量独立同步发明的指标）下降98%的佐证，系统记录了这种相似性的长期衰退趋势。由于同一专利文本的不同表征可能对发明是趋于收敛还是发散得出相反结论，准确衡量这一现象需要严格的验证。我们提出的验证框架——首个针对专利文本的系统性比较方法——能够筛选出最优表征方案。我们构建了一个空间竞争模型，其中发明者在创意空间中选择定位。该模型解释了发明发散现象，并将其与多个独立验证的模式相关联——包括每位发明者研发投入的上升、专利价值的增长、知识溢出的减弱以及研究生产率的下降。其机制具有空间属性：当发明者为开拓新领域而分散布局时，发明价值虽提升，但他人吸收这些发明的成本也随之增加。通过这种方式，模型将溢出强度、创新步长和研究生产率从固定参数转化为发明者定位的结果。经校准的分解分析表明，美国研究生产率的长期下降中约40%可归因于这些空间力量，其余部分则源于传统解释（如资源枯竭效应和知识负担）。在创意空间中，发明者之间的相对位置对经济增长的影响，与发明者数量本身同等重要。

title: Reputation Effects with Endogenous Records
title_zh: 内生记录下的声誉效应
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: I study how the ability to erase records affects patient players’ returns from building reputations. In my model, a patient seller interacts with a sequence of myopic consumers. The seller is either an honest type who always exerts effort and never erases any records, or an opportunistic type who may shirk and can also erase his past actions at a low cost. I show that the seller has an incentive to exert effort until he has a long enough good record, after which his continuation value exceeds his commitment payoff. However, once the seller is sufficiently long-lived, his equilibrium payoff must be close to his minmax value.
abstract_zh: 本文研究记录删除能力如何影响耐心玩家通过建立声誉获得的回报。在模型中，一位耐心卖家与一系列短视消费者进行互动。卖家分为两种类型：一种是始终付出努力且从不删除任何记录的诚实型，另一种是可能偷懒且能以低成本删除过往行为的投机型。研究表明，卖家有动力持续付出努力，直至其积累足够长的良好记录，此时其延续价值将超过承诺收益。然而，一旦卖家存续时间足够长，其均衡收益必然趋近于最小最大值。

title: The AI investment race
official: 官方在线 2026-07-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Focus Exuberance about new technologies often brings about investment booms. The race among firms to capture a share of the revenues can result in excessive investment that makes the boom prone to a disruptive end. The boom-bust cycle recurs across history, from the canal and railway manias of the 19th century to the dotcom boom of the 1990s. The current artificial intelligence (AI) build-out ranks among the largest technology-driven investment booms in US history. Could it share the same fate as prior episodes?
abstract_zh: 对新技术的狂热关注常常引发投资热潮。企业为争夺收入份额而展开的竞争可能导致过度投资，使热潮容易以破坏性结局收场。从19世纪的运河与铁路狂热到20世纪90年代的互联网泡沫，繁荣-萧条周期在历史上反复出现。当前的人工智能基础设施建设规模，堪称美国历史上规模最大的技术驱动型投资热潮之一。它是否会重蹈此前历次热潮的覆辙？
